cities: 3 stores across the US, including Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco · department stores, independent shops, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned: yes, evidenced: factory tour page names the factory in Union, New Jersey (2012-current, 7th location since 1913), says all men's leathers and wool coats are produced there, with photos and video of each step; contact page gives Schott NYC Worldwide Headquarters, 735 Rahway Ave, Union, NJ 07083 (the factory page does not give a street address of its own)
craft_evidence.makers: the house itself: 141 of 277 styles carry Origin "Made in USA" in the product specs, and leather and wool coats are stated to be made in the Union NJ factory; some pages say "Cut & Sewn right here in New Jersey" (jeans JN2402) ; no third-party maker named on imported styles
craft_evidence.mills: yes: Horween (Chicago) tannery named in specs or description on at least 8 leather styles (e.g. P622H, P633SH, P613S, 613MO, P125H, P656H, P693, 213V); Nihon Menpu (Japanese denim) on JN2505/JN2503/JN2301; White Oak / Cone Mills canvas on JN2504; other hides by type and country only (e.g. New Zealand)
craft_evidence.madein: 271 of 277 men's styles state Origin in the PDP spec block (141 Made in USA: nearly all leather jackets and wool coats, all tees and jeans; 3 leather flight jackets A2SM, G1TG, G1S are Imported; 130 Imported: knitwear, shirts, cotton and nylon outerwear, trousers); 6 state none
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: founded 1913 by Irving and Jack Schott in a tenement basement on Manhattan's Lower East Side (96 East Broadway shown); factory in South Amboy NJ by 1930, Perth Amboy factories 1940s-2002, Union NJ 2012-current; first Perfecto 1928
craft_evidence.process: yes: factory tour documents 10 steps (raw-material colour matching, hand cutting of leather with a razor blade, machine stack-cutting of liners, a 25-ton Herman Schwabe die cutter from the Perth Amboy factory, bundling, inside-out shell assembly, turning and inspection, hardware, final inspection with individual numbering, shipping)
craft_evidence.reasoning: Schott makes its own leather jackets and wool coats in its factory in Union, New Jersey, which the factory tour shows step by step with photos and video, and its contact page gives the Union headquarters address. Leather pages name the Horween tannery and the jeans name Japanese and Cone Mills denim. This is not a 5 because 130 of 277 men's styles (knitwear, shirts, cotton and nylon outerwear, trousers) are only "Imported" and name no maker.
